title: Your customers
summary: Everyone who booked, bought or claimed from you, by their WhatsApp number: visits, spend, notes and birthdays.

steps.title: Open Customers
steps.body: Tap Customers in the bar at the bottom. Everyone is here once, by their WhatsApp number, whether they booked, came in or claimed a drop.

steps.title: Find and sort
steps.body: Search by name or number (0803…, 803… or +234… all work). Sort by recent, most visits or top spenders, or filter: people who owe you, people you haven't seen lately, walk-ins, people from drops.

steps.title: Open a customer
steps.body: See every visit, what they spent, what they owe, no-shows, and their next booking. Add notes like "sensitive scalp" and their birthday (day and month). Only you see them.

steps.title: Message, book or remind
steps.body: Tap Message to open WhatsApp on your phone. "Book them in" adds a booking with their details filled in. If they owe you, send a reminder or a pay link.

steps.title: Is this the same person?
steps.body: Customers saved before without a number show as their own. Add their number, or answer "Is this the same person?" when Tikka spots a match, and their visits and notes join up.

tips: Only you see your customers' numbers. Your team never does.
